services.name: Museum Rental
services.desc: The Las Vegas Science & Natural History Museum today announced that it has joined Museums for All, a signature access program of the Institute of Museum and Library Services (IMLS), administered by the Association of Children’s Museums (ACM). This national initiative encourages people of all backgrounds to visit museums regularly and build lifelong museum-going habits by reducing financial barriers to entry. Participation in Museums for All at the Las Vegas Science & Natural History Museum will go into effect on December 1. services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Bring educational fun to your students this school year and book a field trip to the Las Vegas Science & Natural History Museum! The Las Vegas Science & Natural History Museum offers engaging, standards-aligned K-12 field trip programs that bring science, history, and the natural world to life through immersive exhibits and hands-on learning experiences. Our field trips take students beyond the classroom to explore topics in life science, earth science, physical science, history, culture, and STEM, inspiring curiosity and discovery for learners of all grade levels and school types.
